answer: A Verified email inbox bound by challenge-response signature with annual re-verification ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone opal cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. No vertex is counted twice and no terrace is skipped: the ledger reconciles every binding.
